item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J00025","case1_error":"Computes gas cost from miles directly, omitting division by 10 miles per gallon; gas costs $60, not $600.","case2_error":"Counts the 30-minute break as driving time, adding 30 miles that were never traveled.","reason":"The first omits a required unit conversion; the second applies driving speed to non-driving time.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00026","case1_error":"Performs four halving-and-donation rounds instead of the requested two.","case2_error":"Evaluates noon minus 8 AM as eight hours instead of four.","reason":"The first executes extra iterations; the second numerically miscalculates a correctly specified time difference.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00027","case1_error":"Counts the two parent lambs again even though they are already included in the original six.","case2_error":"Subtracts only one week's 12 required chores from two weeks' total, instead of subtracting 24.","reason":"The first double-counts an included subset; the second fails to scale a weekly baseline to the full duration.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00028","case1_error":"After correct group formulas, introduces unsupported totals and sums four terms, including an extra 64, instead of three group totals.","case2_error":"Gives an unsupported final revenue of $168 after a correct verbal procedure; the actual revenue is $216.","reason":"The first explicitly shows a malformed aggregation with an extra term; the second provides no calculation explaining its wrong final number.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J00029","case1_error":"States the correct formulas but supplies an unsupported final answer of 19 instead of 9.","case2_error":"Adds the six sold cows instead of subtracting them, producing 95 instead of 83.","reason":"The first has an unexplained wrong number after correct formulas; the second explicitly models a decrease as an increase.","judgment":"different"}]}
